stem: The professor explained that in order to make a complex phenomenon more ____, economists often reduce it to an abstract problem.

The great divide between science and the humanities appeared during the last decades of the nineteenth century: before then, most people had seen those realms of human thoughts as (i)____. It would therefore be (ii)____ us to study early or mid-nineteenth-century science as something completely separates from the art of the time.

Despite its title and the recipes it provides, the main purpose of The Insect Cookbook is not (i)____. Instead, the book seeks to (ii)____ of entomophagy, i.e. the consumption of insects as food: it is composed of interviews with chefs, farmers, politicians, and United Nations figures, all of whom attempt to (iii)____ the custom of eating insects.
colsZh: 代表……劝人改变信仰或立场
使失去信誉；怀疑其真实性

stem: According to Waters, Cheryl Fish’s otherwise brilliant analysis of Mary Seacole is ____ by a postmodern penchant for inventive jargon and fuzzy metaphysics.

optsZh: 引人入胜的；有说服力的
